release_notes: New: remote MCP over a URL. The tracker serves MCP over HTTP from mcp.php, so an AI assistant connects by pasting https://your-tracker/mcp.php?k=KEY into Claude's 'Add custom connector' — no Node, no local clone, and it is the only route that works in the browser version of Claude. Users -> API Keys copies the ready URL for you. Fixes local (uploaded) landings. Their files live in /landings/<id>/ but the page is served at the campaign URL, so every relative path — images, video, fonts, stylesheets — was requested from the domain root and returned 404: landings rendered as bare text. Assets are now resolved against the landing the visitor was shown, with byte ranges (Safari needs them for <video>), ETag/304 and caching, so uploaded archives work untouched exactly as they do in Keitaro. Also fixed: .webp, .mp4 and other media requests used to fall through into campaign matching, which could log a phantom click and return HTML in place of the file; the bot blacklists on Settings -> Bots did nothing at all (adding, deleting and clearing were no-ops that still reported success — if you added a blacklist before this release, add it again); CSRF is now enforced on every method that can change data, not on POST alone.
